Bill.BriefDescription: Designating certain state routes as highways of statewide significance.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the designation of certain state routes ashighways of statewide significance; and adding a new section to chapter47.05 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following highways are of statewide significance: (1) That portion of state route number 11 that runs from Interstate5 to 12th Street near the Alaska Marine Highway System ferry terminalin Bellingham; (2) That portion of state route number 529 from the port of Everettnorth to Interstate 5 near Marysville; and (3) State route number 599, as defined in RCW 47.17.808.
